summary: Extracts SOP point, vertex, primitive, detail, group, and attribute data into DAT table columns for inspection, scripting, export, or round-trip data workflows.

key_params.name: extract
key_params.note: Extract points, vertices, primitives, or detail data

key_params.name: group
key_params.note: Limit extraction to a point or primitive group

key_params.name: attrib
key_params.note: Attribute names or patterns to include

key_params.name: uvforpts
key_params.note: Copy vertex UV attributes to point rows when extracting point data

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom editor extension when Extension is set to Custom Extension

key_params.name: extension
key_params.note: Edit/view file extension exposed to external editors

key_params.name: wordwrap
key_params.note: Common DAT node-display word wrap setting

common_gotchas: Large SOPs can produce very large DAT tables; use groups and attribute filters to keep the table bounded.
Multi-value attributes become multiple columns such as attrib(0), attrib(1), and attrib(2), so downstream code should not assume one column per attribute.
Point, vertex, primitive, and detail extraction modes expose different topology levels.
Copying vertex UVs to points can change data semantics when multiple vertices share one point.
key_concepts: Extracts point, vertex, primitive, or detail data from a SOP into DAT columns.
The first output column is an index for point or primitive number.
Attributes can be extracted by name and multi-value attributes expand to numbered columns.
Copy Vertex UV to Points copies vertex UV data to point UV columns when extracting point data.
